dispatch_policy: Dispatch tasks with status ready_to_dispatch as a P1 Wave A Generator batch (3 parallel). When a generator finishes, promote the next queued task (lowest dispatch_order) to ready_to_dispatch and dispatch it. Rotate through all 16 territories until the queue is drained.
shard_format: JSONL, one candidate idea per line. Required fields per line: candidate_id (territory-scoped, e.g. samp-0001), territory, title, core_claim, method_sketch, evidence_label (one of the research_state.json evidence_policy labels), novelty_hook, kill_risk. Generators must NOT fabricate citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or experimental results (evidence_policy.forbid_fiction).
generator_rules: Write ONLY to your assigned output_shard_path under Windows16/_state/tasks/P1/.
Do NOT modify Windows16/_state/window.lock.json, research_state.json, or ideas_master.jsonl (merge into master is a later consolidator's job).
Do NOT scan or increment Windows numbers and do NOT create Windows directories.
Hit target_candidate_count within the 80-120 band; prefer breadth and dedupe within your own shard.

tasks.territory: SAM/PEFT: Segment Anything family adaptation, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/adapters/prompt tuning) for segmentation foundation models
Medical segmentation: organs/lesions/tumors, modality-specific challenges (CT/MRI/US/pathology), annotation scarcity, clinical deployment constraints
Smoke/fire/ambiguous-boundary targets: wildfire smoke, translucent/amorphous/fuzzy-boundary object segmentation and detection, soft labels for ill-defined extents
Object detection: open-vocabulary, small/dense objects, long-tail classes, label noise, detection-specific training and evaluation gaps
VLM/dense prediction: vision-language models for dense tasks, grounding, referring segmentation, pixel-level alignment between text and image features
Failure mining: systematic error-case discovery, hard-example mining, model debugging, slice discovery, turning failure taxonomies into methods or benchmarks
Benchmark weaknesses: label errors, saturation, shortcut exploitation, metric blind spots, contamination; ideas that expose or repair flawed evaluation
Uncertainty: calibration, conformal prediction, epistemic/aleatoric decomposition, selective prediction, uncertainty for dense/pixel tasks and safety-critical use
Synthetic data: generative/simulated training data, sim-to-real, synthetic-data curricula, contamination-safe eval sets, data-quality vs quantity trade-offs
Domain shift: domain adaptation/generalization, test-time adaptation, distribution-shift robustness, cross-site/cross-sensor transfer
Negative results: rigorous refutations of popular assumptions, 'X does not actually help' studies, reproduction failures reframed as publishable findings
Contrarian: deliberately against-the-grain bets (simpler-is-better, anti-scaling, anti-foundation-model, revive-old-methods) with falsifiable claims
SR/restoration: super-resolution, denoising, deblurring, low-light, compression artifacts; perceptual vs fidelity trade-offs and restoration-for-downstream-tasks
Diffusion: diffusion/flow models as priors, editors, data engines, or perception backbones; efficiency, controllability, and discriminative uses of generative models
LLM/agent: LLM-driven agents for vision/research workflows, tool use, self-verification, agentic data curation and annotation, agent evaluation
Cross-field: imports from other disciplines (physics, biology, economics, control, information theory, HCI) into vision/ML problems, and vision techniques exported outward
